system.creatureSubtype: Immune to poison damage, Poisoned condition, disease, exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified. Mindless: immune to mind-affecting effects, fear, psychic effects. Does not need air, food, drink, or sleep.
system.tactics: Stone golems advance inexorably, using Slow to cripple multiple enemies before crushing them with massive slams. They ignore most damage types and magic, making them terrifying juggernauts. Golems follow orders literally and never retreat.
system.attacksNotes:
Slam [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 6 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 10 ft

  • Margin 1:: 20 damage (12 + 8 Str)
  • Margin 2: 20 damage, DR halved (round up)
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Large Size: Occupies 10×10 ft space, 10 ft reach. Magic Resistance: Subtract 1 from both dice on saving throws against magical effects. Slow (Recharge 6-8) [Combat]: Targets up to 3 creatures within 10 feet. Targets make Will [Easy] save adding 1 to both Will save dice: 0 Successes: Can only take 2 actions per turn (instead of 3) and cannot take reactions for 1 minute. Affected creatures can repeat save at end of each turn. Immutable Form: Immune to any weave that would alter its form (transformation, Beastial Transformation, etc.) Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
